drafts.draft: Cepheid is working on updates to GeneXpert to run faster and test for more targets at once. That combination (speed plus plex) is the thing I always watch for in point-of-care infectious disease, because those two usually trade off against each other in ways that matter a lot at the instrument level. Nothing shipped yet, just something I'm keeping an eye on from the diagnostics corner of my feed.

drafts.draft: Genomtec raised €2.6M for molecular test commercialization and AI-based assay development. I don't know much about them beyond that headline, but the combination catches my eye (AI for assay development is something I keep watching from the software side of diagnostics). POC molecular plus AI-assisted development is a crowded pitch right now. Curious whether the AI piece is upstream in design or downstream in interpretation. Probably both, honestly. Either way, €2.6M is a real but modest number for commercializing hardware-adjacent molecular tests.
